Author: NearVoice contributors; original by Ricimon
Name: NearVoice
Description: Automatic world/map proximity, quiet connection/map changes, bounded audio buffers, Turkish font and optional talking animation. 0.2.2 disables old default join/leave beeps once while preserving microphone and other settings. /yakin opens the panel.

Author: XeldarAlz; local Discord adaptation
Name: Aethr App (local Discord)
Punchline: Your existing phone interface with your Discord friends.
Description: Private local edition based on Aetherphone. Uses official Discord authorization for contacts and text chat. Aethernet services and unchecked native media/browser playback are disabled.

Author: YF
Name: Musical Guide (local camera R12)
Description: R12: retires physical webcam camera steering; facial webcam stays in NearFace. Automatic hand-clipping preference is migrated once, with fresh native projection verification after map changes. Detects a loaded old MusicalGuide copy and retries strict binding when it is unloaded. Local head mask is available with matching Customize+ for every installation. Retains R11 mount crash recovery; rider-head mounted positioning remains withdrawn. Existing FOV/offsets retained. Restart after update.
Punchline: Enhanced camera distance control and first-person experience.

Author: Risa and Contributors
Name: Customize+ (local NearFace fork)
Punchline: Customize your character beyond FFXIV's limitations.
Description: Customize+ with cooperative local NearFace layers: current facial frames, calibrated eyelids, lip expressions, optional approximate pupil/cheek offsets and independent native Character-preview ownership. Original C+ profiles remain intact. No other-player synchronization; visual sculpt acceptance pending.

Author: NearFace contributors
Name: NearFace (face + compact mirror)
Description: Explicit-start local facial webcam. Facial continuity no longer depends on camera head-pose acquisition. /nearface mirror is a small movable/resizable character preview; right-click for framing controls. Optional approximate iris direction and smile-linked cheeks, with bounded previews. Matching Customize+ 2.2.1.8 required. Physical webcam camera steering is retired. Tongue and measured cheek puff are unavailable. No other-player face/look synchronization. Native visual acceptance is pending.
Punchline: Local face controls and read-only bone inventory for the matching C+ fork.
